<meta property="og:description" content="Why are we alive? The length and the depth of a life — which is it that matters?">
就在你閱讀的這段時間，全球已有
In the time you have been reading this, the world has lost
人離世
people
勞碌一生
A lifetime of toil
活著，到底是為了什麼？
So why are we alive at all?
生命 : 長度 : 濃度
Life : Length : Depth
到底為了甚麼?
For what, exactly?
只是一個被記錄的數字嗎？
Just a number in a record?
繼 續
C O N T I N U E
若驀然離去
If you were suddenly taken away
最放不下什麼？
What would you hold on to most?
大多數人沒想過這個問題
Most people never ask it
直到來不及的那一天
Until the day it is too late
返 回
B A C K
你相信死後
Do you believe that after death
還有「你」嗎？
there is still a "you"?
什麼都沒有，人死如燈滅
Nothing — the candle simply goes out
輪迴轉世，繼續下一段旅程
Reincarnation, on to the next journey
靈魂是永遠，今只生如單程票
The soul is eternal; this life is a one-way ticket
不知道
I don't know
如果死後，什麼都沒有
If after death there is nothing
一生的掙扎
A lifetime of struggle
義人的善，惡人的惡，意義何在？
The good of the righteous, the evil of the wicked — what sense is there in it?
若終點是虛無
If the end is nothingness
為何會恐懼死亡？
Why fear death at all?
輪迴
Reincarnation
苦海無涯，回頭是岸
The sea of suffering is boundless — turn back and find the shore
脫離輪迴苦海
To escape the sea of suffering and rebirth
何不尋一道，直達永恆？
Why not find a way straight to eternity?
天堂和地獄
Heaven and Hell
入門卷是甚麼？
What is the entry ticket?
好人？善事？
Good people? Good deeds?
誰來定標準？
Who sets the standard?
你有把握嗎？
Are you sure?
從沒認真想過
Never really thought about it
不代表問題不存在
Doesn't mean the question isn't there
可以不想
You can choose not to think about it
卻躲不過
But you cannot escape it
人人都有一死
Everyone must die
而沒人在乎去處，這不奇怪嗎？
And nobody cares where they go — is that not strange?
我們都一樣
We are all the same
「其實明天如何，我們還不知道。
"As for tomorrow, we do not know what it will bring.
我們的生命是甚麼呢？
What is our life?
我們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。」
We are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes."
— James 4:14
有一條路
There is a way
不再懼怕
To fear no more
因為...
Because...
「 神愛世人，甚至將祂的獨生子賜給他們
"For God so loved the world that He gave His only Son,
叫一切信祂的，不致滅亡，反得永生。」
that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."
— 約翰福音 3:16
— John 3:16
我想知道更多
I want to know more
讓我再想想
Let me think about it
一個事實
A fact
太初有道
In the beginning was the Word
道與　神同在，道就是　神
and the Word was with God, and the Word was God
這道太初與　神同在
He was in the beginning with God.
萬物是藉著他造的
All things were made through him,
凡被造的
and without him nothing was made that has been made.
沒有一樣不是藉著他造的
In him was life, and the life was the light of all people.
生命在他裡頭，這生命就是人的光
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
光照在黑暗裡，黑暗卻不接受光
To all who did receive him, to those who believe in his name, he gave the right to become children of God.
凡接待他的，就是信他名的人
He is not God made of stone, but living in the hearts of those who love him.
他就賜他們權柄作　神的兒女
And those who did receive him, to those who believe in his name,
祂說: 「我就是道路、真理、生命
He said: "I am the way, and the truth, and the life.
若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。」
No one comes to the Father except through me."
— 約翰福音 14:6
— John 14:6
我想了解多些
I'd like to know more

《福音》就是好消息(Good News)的意思
"Gospel" simply means Good News
你若願意
If you are willing
可以這樣禱告
you can pray like this
主耶穌基督，我相信祢是獨一的真 神
Lord Jesus Christ, I believe You are the one true God.
謝謝祢的愛，我相信祢為贖我的罪
Thank You for Your love. I believe You died for my sins,
曾被釘死在十字架上，但已經復活了！
were crucified on the cross, and You have risen again!
我承認自己曾經做錯了許多事，求祢赦免我一切的過犯。
I confess I have done many wrong things. Please forgive all my wrongdoing.
親愛的主耶穌，我願意接受祢作我唯一的救主。
Dear Lord Jesus, I am willing to receive You as my only Saviour.
我願意打開我的心，求祢進到我的生命裡
I am willing to open my heart and invite You into my life.
求祢成為我的救主，我的拯救，永遠與我同在！
Be my Saviour, my salvation, and stay with me always!
求祢帶領我走在祢永生的路上
Lead me along Your path of eternal life.
奉主耶穌基督的名禱告，阿們！
In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!

🎉 恭喜您！
🎉 Congratulations!
如果你真心這樣禱告了。
If you have prayed this in your heart,
恭喜您! 你已經成為 神的兒女了!
congratulations — you are now a child of God!
死亡不再是終點，而是回天家的大門。
Death is no longer the end; it is the gate home.
願我們在天家裡相見
May we meet again in our Father's house,
願主祝福你，阿們
and may the Lord bless you. Amen.
祂是笑臉幫助我們
He is the God who helps with a smile,
是不斥責人的 神
the God who does not reproach,
祂以我們的默念為甘甜。
and who takes our silent meditation as sweetness.
我們既然藉著主耶穌基督
Since we have been reconciled to God through Jesus Christ,
得與　神和好，也就藉著他以　神為樂
we have joy in God through him,
真實地可以與祂一同生活
so that we may truly live with him,
一起面對所有問題
and face all our problems together,
相信祂的應許
trusting in his promise,
盼望祂再來的那天來到。
and looking forward to the day he comes again.
願主祝福你
The Lord bless you,
使你能夠深深認識祂，相信祂。
so that you may know him deeply and believe in him.
祂必喜悅你
He will be pleased with you
以真誠和愛心去回應祂的真情。
as you respond to his love with sincerity and love.
願我們一起同走這永生之路
May we walk this eternal road together,
可在天家裡相見，阿們。
and meet in our Father's house. Amen.
